codec.name: avc
codec.tool_version: ffmpeg version n7.1.1-56-gc2184b65d2 Copyright (c) 2000-2025 the FFmpeg developers

limitations: Native codec invocation uses ffmpeg CLI subprocess rather than in-process C-API bindings.
Subsampled chroma (yuv420p) introduces high-frequency colour quantization relative to full RGB.
Full-range mapping provides <= 1 grey level precision across [-255, 255], while clipped mode bounds to [-128, 127].
